articles.title: We Love This Listing: a Malibu home that looks up as well as out
articles.deck: An ocean outlook and a private observatory put two very different kinds of sky in the same property story.
paragraphs: Two ways to enjoy the setting

In its 2026-11-06 report, Robb Report describes a Malibu residence with an ocean outlook and a private observatory. That pairing is the reason for this coastal selection. The source calls it ocean-view; we are not turning that into a claim of direct frontage, beach ownership or shore access.
Why we love this listing

The unusual room is a useful starting point, but the real appeal is the routine it suggests: time outside, a changing horizon and somewhere to look beyond the familiar view. A distinctive feature earns its place when it changes how a home might be enjoyed, rather than merely extending an inventory.
The practical reading

We would ask how the observatory and outdoor areas relate to the spaces used every day. Equipment, access, condition and local constraints belong in a specific property review. Follow the original publication for the reported design details, asking terms and photography; confirm present availability with the listing professional.

articles.title: We Love This Listing: La Paloma’s restored Montecito character
articles.deck: A Montecito property story makes the case for character that survives a new chapter.
paragraphs: The story behind the house

Sotheby’s International Realty’s 2026-11-03 feature identifies an early twentieth-century design by Mary McLaughlin Craig and later restoration and expansion by Xorin Balbes. Those are source-reported architectural credits, not an inspection or an interview conducted by this magazine.
Why we love this listing

A grand house can make an entrance. The more interesting question is what remains inviting after that first impression. Here, the appeal is the relationship between inherited character and later decisions: a home can gain another chapter without treating its history as a decorative label.
Look beyond the first photograph

For a property like this, we would read circulation, garden connections and everyday rooms alongside the formal spaces. Restoration is a reason to look more closely, not a substitute for current property documents or a qualified review of condition. The original feature supplies the reported detail and credited photography.
